title: Kukura kwakaita HAX
peopleText: Wese akabatsira, achikura achibuda kubva pa{root}: kure kwavari, ndiko kunonoka kwavakapinda. Mumwe nemumwe anopenya nebasa rake richangoburwa (macommit kune chero repository yeHAX, nyaya dzakavhurwa nedzakavharwa mumutsara wenyaya weHAX), achipisa zvikuru paanenge akabatikana uye achidzima mumwedzi inotevera.
peopleKey: Kupenya, kubva pakunyarara kusvika pakupisa kwakachena
selectPerson: Sarudza munhu kuti uone kuti akapinda rini uye zvaakaita.
agentsText: Macommit akanyorwa nevamiriri veAI, vachishanda mumarepository eHAX nevanhu vanovashandisa, kubvira {date}. Pano vanoverengerwa pamwe chete, kwete sevanhu.
noPeople: Hapana data revabatsiri mune ino sosi.
chartHint: Pachiyero chelogarithm, kukwira kwakatwasuka kunoreva kuwanza kwakadzikama, uye kukombama kuenda kumusoro kunoreva kuti kuri kukurumidza.
rateThemes: Madingindira matsva {n} mumwedzi 12 kusvika {date}: rimwe chete mazuva {days} ega ega.
preCore: Madingindira ekutanga aya anouya musimboti wemadingindira unogovaniswa usati wasvika pa{date}; dingindira rega rega pano rinozovakwa pauri.
coreText: Dingindira rega rega rinorodha musimboti mumwe chete unogovaniswa: {core} yakagzip mumafaira {files}. Dingindira rinowanzoitika rinowedzera {own} yaro pachayo, inenge {pct}% yemusimboti. Mahexagon akadhirowewa pachiyero ichocho.
themeCost: Kushanya kwekutanga kusaiti ye{name} kunorodha {first}. Kana mushanyi ambonaona saiti yeclean-one pahost imwe chete, inoda {after} imwe.
twoLayers: Yakavakwa pa{base}, saka inoshandisa zvakare zvidimbu zviviri.
elText: Mapakeji anonyanya kushandiswa ari pakati; zvese zvakaapoteredza zvakavakwa pamusoro pawo. Anonyanya kushandiswa kusvika {date}: {top}. {ddd} pamapakeji aya {n} akavakwa paDDD. Saizi yehexagon ifaira guru repakeji yega yega, rakagzip; mupendero wegoridhe unoratidza mapakeji anoshandiswa nemamwe 20 kana kupfuura.
selectElement: Sarudza chinhu kuti uone zvachinovimba nazvo (orenji) nezvinochishandisa (bhuruu).
platText: Ose anoshanda pachimiro chimwe chete chesaiti, site.json: mamwe anomhanyisa masaiti, mamwe anoavaka kana kuagadzirisa, uye PRAW inochengeta mitemo yacho.
platKey: Ane mavara: masaiti ari mubhawa renetiweki reHAX, mumavara awo enetiweki. Grey: mapuratifomu anomhanyisa nekuvaka HAX. Saizi inokura nemacommit kusvika nhasi; mhete inorova nemacommit emwedzi wega wega.
selectPlat: Sarudza imwe kuti uone kuti ndeyei.
siteIntro: Mushanyi anoverenga mapeji mashoma esaiti imwe yeHAX, obva aenda kusaiti inotevera pahost imwe chete. Pakati pemapeji esaiti, zvinhu zvinowedzerwa nepeji iyoyo chete ndizvo zvinotorwa.
themeIntro: Mushanyi anovhura saiti imwe yeHAX mushure meimwe pahost imwe chete, imwe neimwe iine dingindira rakasiyana, zvichienderana nekurongeka kwakagadzirwa madingindira.
firstStep: Peji rekutanga reHAX pahost rinotora zvese: {need} mumafaira {files}.
laterStep: Nhanho iyi inoda {need}; {cached} yazvo yatova mucache, saka inotora {fetch} chete.
bundleSite: Dai peji rega rega raive bundle raro
bundleTheme: Dai saiti yega yega yaive bundle yayo
unbundled: HAX: mafaira asina kubundlewa, akachengetwa mucache faira nefaira
cacheKey: Maseru eorenji ari kutorwa izvozvi, egoridhe akange atova mucache. Maseru ane mupendero ndiwo musimboti unogovaniswa.
sources: Mazuva: pakaonekwa faira rega rega panzira yaro yazvino, uye commit yekutanga yerepository yega yega. Mabhaiti: gzip yesosi yefaira rega rega, faira nefaira, kodhi yevamwe isina kuverengerwa. Mabhurawuza anochengeta cache imwe pasaiti yega yega, saka zvinochengetedzwa pakati pemasaiti zvinoshanda pahost imwe chete.
drawing: {view} pa{date}: {n} zvaratidzwa. Pani iri padivi payo inoratidza nhamba dzimwe chete.
